senses.en: too sure of yourself or your abilities

example.en: He was overconfident before the exam and didn't study at all.
example.zh: 考试前他过于自信，完全没有复习。

senses.en: a military airport where aircraft are based

example.en: The fighter jets returned to the airbase at dusk.
example.zh: 战斗机在傍晚返回空军基地。

senses.en: the main dish of a meal, especially in a restaurant (North American usage)

example.en: The entree comes with a choice of soup or salad.
example.zh: 主菜可搭配汤或沙拉。

senses.en: the right or opportunity to enter a place or a social group

example.en: His family gave him entree into high society.
example.zh: 他的家庭为他进入上流社会提供了门路。

senses.en: the act of giving a vaccine to protect against a disease

example.en: Vaccination is one of the most effective ways to prevent infectious diseases.
example.zh: 接种疫苗是预防传染病最有效的方法之一。

senses.en: a polite and well-mannered man
senses.zh: 有礼貌、有教养的男士；绅士

example.en: He held the door open for the woman behind him like a true gentleman.
example.zh: 他像真正的绅士一样，为身后的女士扶住了门。

senses.en: a polite word for a man, used especially in formal situations
senses.zh: 先生（对男子的礼貌称呼，尤用于正式场合）

example.en: Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats.
example.zh: 女士们、先生们，请就座。

senses.en: a man of high social position, especially in the past
senses.zh: （尤指旧时的）绅士，有地位的男子

example.en: The old house once belonged to a wealthy gentleman.
example.zh: 这座老房子曾属于一位富有的绅士。

senses.en: the act of thinking carefully about something

example.en: After careful consideration, she accepted the offer.
example.zh: 经过仔细考虑，她接受了这个提议。

senses.en: a fact or issue that should be kept in mind when making a decision
senses.zh: 需要考虑的因素；考虑事项

example.en: Price is an important consideration when buying a car.
example.zh: 买车时，价格是一个重要的考虑因素。

senses.en: payment or something given in return for something

example.en: He received a small sum in consideration for his work.
example.zh: 他因工作收到了一小笔报酬。

senses.en: in a similar way

example.en: She dressed similarly to her sister.
example.zh: 她穿得和她姐姐相似。

senses.en: good at doing something because of practice or training

example.en: She is a skillful driver who handles traffic easily.
example.zh: 她是一位技术娴熟的司机，能轻松应对交通。

senses.en: done with great skill and care

example.en: The chef prepared the fish with skillful knife work.
example.zh: 厨师用精湛的刀工处理了这条鱼。

senses.en: the money charged for sending a letter or package by mail

example.en: The postage for this package is eight dollars.
example.zh: 这个包裹的邮费是八美元。

senses.en: a person who visits or telephones a place

example.en: The caller left a message on my voicemail.
example.zh: 来电者在我的语音信箱里留了言。

senses.en: a person who calls out numbers or names, e.g. at bingo or a dance
senses.zh: （宾果游戏、舞会等的）报号员，喊名者

example.en: The bingo caller announced the next number.
example.zh: 宾果报号员报出了下一个号码。

senses.en: smooth and bright because it reflects light

example.en: Her new shoes are very shiny.
example.zh: 她的新鞋非常光亮。

senses.en: a male member of the United States House of Representatives

example.en: The congressman voted against the new bill.
example.zh: 这位众议员投票反对新法案。

senses.en: (usually the Gospels) the four New Testament books about the life and teachings of Jesus Christ

example.en: The Gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John are at the start of the New Testament.
example.zh: 《马太福音》《马可福音》《路加福音》和《约翰福音》位于新约的开篇。

senses.en: an unquestionable truth or guiding principle

example.en: He treats every word of the manual as gospel.
example.zh: 他把手册里的每句话都当作真理。

senses.en: a style of religious music

example.en: She sings gospel in the church choir.
example.zh: 她在教堂唱诗班唱福音音乐。

senses.en: the message or teachings of Jesus Christ

example.en: Missionaries traveled far to spread the gospel.
example.zh: 传教士远赴各地传播福音。

senses.en: pale and looking tired or unwell

example.en: She looked wan after a sleepless night.
example.zh: 一夜未眠后，她显得苍白憔悴。

senses.en: weak or faint, especially of light or a smile

example.en: He gave a wan smile.
example.zh: 他露出一丝无力的微笑。

senses.en: (capitalized: WAN) wide area network, a computer network spanning a large geographic area
senses.zh: 广域网（wide area network 的缩写，通常写作 WAN）

example.en: The company uses a WAN to connect its offices.
example.zh: 公司使用广域网连接办公室。

senses.en: the act of cleaning a place or removing dirt or waste

example.en: Volunteers organized a cleanup of the beach on Saturday.
example.zh: 志愿者周六组织了一次海滩清理活动。

senses.en: (informal, especially US) a large profit
senses.zh: 暴利；巨额利润（非正式，多用于美式英语）

example.en: They made a huge cleanup on the stock deal.
example.zh: 他们在这笔股票交易中赚了一大笔暴利。

senses.en: the form of a word used to show there is more than one

example.en: The plural of "child" is "children".
example.zh: “child”的复数是“children”。

senses.en: relating to or consisting of more than one

example.en: The word "books" is the plural form of "book".
example.zh: “books”是“book”的复数形式。

senses.en: feeling or showing sadness

example.en: She gave a sorrowful look when she heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，她露出了悲伤的神情。

senses.en: a member or supporter of the Democratic Party in the United States
senses.zh: 美国民主党党员（或支持者）

example.en: She has been a Democrat since she first voted.
example.zh: 她从第一次投票起就是民主党人。

senses.en: a person who believes in or supports democracy and equal rights for all
senses.zh: 民主主义者；信奉民主原则的人

example.en: He was a true democrat who believed everyone deserved a voice.
example.zh: 他是一个真正信奉民主的人，认为每个人都应有发言权。

senses.en: the way a person or group lives, including habits, activities and choices

example.en: A healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise and a balanced diet.
example.zh: 健康的生活方式包括经常锻炼和均衡饮食。

senses.en: having no people living there

example.en: They landed on an uninhabited island.
example.zh: 他们在一座无人居住的岛上登陆。

senses.en: a boat designed or used as a home

example.en: They spent the summer living on a houseboat.
example.zh: 他们夏天住在一艘船屋上。

senses.en: payment made to compensate someone for loss, damage, or injury

example.en: The court ordered him to pay full restitution to the victims.
example.zh: 法院命令他向受害者支付全额赔偿。

senses.en: the act of returning something to its rightful owner or original state

example.en: The museum agreed to the restitution of the stolen artifacts.
example.zh: 博物馆同意归还被盗的文物。

senses.en: a man who cares greatly about his stylish dress and appearance
senses.zh: 花花公子，讲究穿着的男子

example.en: The young dandy spent hours choosing his outfit.
example.zh: 这位年轻的花花公子花了好几个小时挑选行头。

senses.en: very good (informal, often in phrases)

example.en: The crops came up fine and dandy this year.
example.zh: 今年的庄稼长势相当好。

senses.en: used before a plural noun to point to specific people or things, especially ones farther away or already mentioned
senses.zh: 那些；指较远或已提到的复数人或事物

example.en: Those shoes by the door are mine.
example.zh: 门边那双鞋是我的。

senses.en: used to refer to plural people or things that are farther away or already mentioned
senses.zh: 那些；指较远或已提到的复数人或事物

example.en: I like these better than those.
example.zh: 比起那些，我更喜欢这些。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

example.en: We walked through the forest for hours.
example.zh: 我们在森林里走了几个小时。

senses.en: a large number of tall things standing close together

example.en: The city was a forest of glass towers.
example.zh: 这座城市是一片玻璃高塔的森林。

senses.en: past tense of rise; moved upward
senses.zh: rise 的过去式；上升，升起

example.en: She rose from her chair to greet us.
example.zh: 她从椅子上站起来迎接我们。

senses.en: a flower with a sweet smell, often red, pink, or white

example.en: He gave her a red rose.
example.zh: 他送给她一朵红玫瑰。

senses.en: a soft pink or reddish color

example.en: The walls were painted a soft rose.
example.zh: 墙壁被漆成柔和的玫瑰色。

senses.en: to make someone believe that something is true or persuade them to do something

example.en: She convinced me that the plan would work.
example.zh: 她使我相信这个计划会行得通。

senses.en: a picture or visual representation of someone or something

example.en: She sent me an image of the map.
example.zh: 她给我发了一张地图的图像。

senses.en: the way a person or organization is seen by others

example.en: The company worked hard to improve its public image.
example.zh: 公司努力改善其公众形象。

senses.en: to make a picture or copy of something

example.en: The camera can image objects in low light.
example.zh: 这台相机能在弱光下拍摄物体的图像。

senses.en: a device that reads documents or images and copies them into a computer
senses.zh: 扫描仪；把文件或图像读入电脑的设备

example.en: She placed the photo on the scanner and saved it as a PDF.
example.zh: 她把照片放在扫描仪上，并将其保存为 PDF。

senses.en: a medical machine that makes images of the inside of the body
senses.zh: 医学扫描仪；用于拍摄身体内部图像的机器

example.en: The hospital bought a new scanner for brain imaging.
example.zh: 医院购买了一台用于脑部成像的新扫描仪。

senses.en: a computer program that checks files or networks for viruses or problems
senses.zh: 扫描程序；检查文件或网络是否有病毒或问题的计算机程序

example.en: The antivirus scanner found a suspicious file.
example.zh: 杀毒扫描程序发现了一个可疑文件。

senses.en: to organize people or resources for action

example.en: The government mobilized thousands of workers to clean up after the flood.
example.zh: 政府动员了数千名工人开展洪灾后的清理工作。

senses.en: to call military personnel into active service

example.en: The country mobilized its army within days of the crisis.
example.zh: 危机发生后几天内，该国就动员了军队。

senses.en: to remove written or printed text

example.en: Please delete the last sentence from the paragraph.
example.zh: 请把这段话的最后一句删掉。

senses.en: to remove data or files from a computer or device

example.en: She deleted the old photos from her phone.
example.zh: 她删掉了手机里的旧照片。

senses.en: a very short moment of time

example.en: For an instant, she couldn't remember his name.
example.zh: 有那么一瞬间，她记不起他的名字了。

senses.en: happening immediately, without delay

example.en: The medicine gave instant relief from the pain.
example.zh: 这药立刻缓解了疼痛。

senses.en: prepared quickly and easily, often just by adding water

example.en: She made a cup of instant coffee before leaving for work.
example.zh: 她上班前冲了一杯速溶咖啡。

senses.en: to go down or rest on your knees

example.en: She knelt down to pick up the coin.
example.zh: 她跪下来捡起硬币。

senses.en: following the traditional or commonly accepted beliefs and practices

example.en: His methods are quite orthodox, but they work well.
example.zh: 他的方法相当正统，但很有效。

senses.en: of or relating to the Eastern Orthodox Church

example.en: She attends an Orthodox church in the city.
example.zh: 她在城里一座东正教教堂做礼拜。

senses.en: a large group of musicians playing instruments together, especially strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion

example.en: The orchestra played a beautiful symphony at the concert hall.
example.zh: 管弦乐团在音乐厅演奏了一首优美的交响曲。

senses.en: the section of seats on the main floor of a theater, closest to the stage

example.en: We paid extra for seats in the orchestra.
example.zh: 我们多花了钱买正厅前排的座位。

senses.en: to move an organ or tissue from one body to another in surgery

example.en: Doctors transplanted a kidney from her brother.
example.zh: 医生把她的哥哥的肾脏移植给了她。

senses.en: to move a plant from one place and plant it elsewhere

example.en: We transplanted the seedlings into larger pots.
example.zh: 我们把幼苗移栽到了更大的花盆里。

senses.en: an operation or instance of moving an organ or tissue to another body

example.en: The patient is waiting for a heart transplant.
example.zh: 病人正在等待心脏移植手术。

senses.en: the feeling of being sad; sorrow

example.en: She felt deep sadness after her friend moved away.
example.zh: 朋友搬走后，她感到深深的悲伤。

senses.en: to learn something so that you remember it exactly

example.en: She memorized the poem in one evening.
example.zh: 她一个晚上就把那首诗背下来了。

senses.en: good at convincing people to believe or do something

example.en: Her persuasive speech won the team many supporters.
example.zh: 她有说服力的演讲为团队赢得了许多支持者。

senses.en: a group of performers, especially actors, dancers or singers, who tour together

example.en: A small theatre troupe performed for the villagers.
example.zh: 一个小剧团为村民们表演。

senses.en: not proper or suitable for a person of good manners or status

example.en: Such language is unbecoming of an officer.
example.zh: 这样的言辞有失一位军官的身份。

senses.en: silly and pointless; foolish

example.en: He made a fatuous remark that nobody laughed at.
example.zh: 他说了句愚蠢的话，没有人觉得好笑。

senses.en: a layer of rock, soil, or similar material lying parallel to the surface

example.en: Fossils were found in the deepest stratum.
example.zh: 化石在最深的地层中被发现。

senses.en: a social class or level of society

example.en: The policy affects every stratum of society.
example.zh: 这项政策影响到社会的各个阶层。

senses.en: very frightening or horrible

example.en: The film tells a ghastly story of a haunted house.
example.zh: 这部电影讲了一个鬼屋的骇人故事。

senses.en: very bad or unpleasant

example.en: The weather turned ghastly on our trip.
example.zh: 旅途中天气变得非常糟糕。

senses.en: working or studying for the whole standard working week

example.en: She has a full-time job at the hospital.
example.zh: 她在医院有一份全职工作。

senses.en: for the standard number of working hours

example.en: He works full-time now.
example.zh: 他现在全职工作。

senses.en: remains of destroyed buildings or places

example.en: Tourists explored the ruins of the ancient temple.
example.zh: 游客们参观了古庙的遗迹。

senses.en: to destroy or spoil something completely

example.en: The heavy rain ruined our picnic.
example.zh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐。
